resources.string: Required for Clock Time features. Turn on once during setup.
Protects Clock Time settings. Turn off device protection before uninstalling. A parent can help when this app is no longer needed.
Tap to reopen Clock Time during initial setup.
Tap to continue permissions and pairing
Please enter the account password for the parent device
Please enter the verification code for the parent device
Use the parent password from the parent app Settings. Works offline after this phone has synced once. Or tap Use Verification Code when online.
Please check the verification code on the parent device\'s Alerts page (Notice → Alerts). Verification codes need internet.
Verification code sent to the parent app. Open Alerts on the parent phone and enter the code here.
Parent verification is required before device protection can be turned off.
No internet connection. Check Wi‑Fi or mobile data and try again.
No internet, and this phone hasn\'t saved the parent password yet. Connect once so it can unlock offline next time.
Verification codes need internet. Use the parent password instead (works offline after a prior sync).
Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
This phone isn\'t connected to the parent account yet. Open Clock Time and finish setup, then try again.
No parent password is set yet. Tap Use Verification Code, or set a password in the parent app Settings.
